intent.experiment: OnceNet training by matching factorial confirmation
intent.purpose: Separate the contribution of existing mathematical pretraining from negative-aware matching on fresh labeled real spectrograms.
intent.weights: Existing v46 spectrogram checkpoints paired with each seed's exact saved v45 random initialization. All seeds retained; no winner selection.
intent.inputs: Same authentic 0.5,1,2,4 second renders, full and low-frequency views, fixed deployed preprocessing, identical spatial-statistic descriptor in all four conditions.
intent.runtime_intent: Strict FP32 CUDA with TF32 and mixed precision disabled; all historical features recomputed identically. Compare to CPU on already-used fixtures before freezing.
intent.fit_and_calibration: Identical historical FIT and CAL identities per target; ELDA uses FIT, cosine ignores FIT by design. Threshold calibrated separately for each condition on the same CAL, with conservative ties.
intent.primary_endpoint: Macro standardized partial AUROC at max false-positive rate 0.001
co_primary_contrasts: trained minus random averaged over matchers
ELDA minus cosine averaged over training conditions
intent.co_primary_intervals: Two-sided97.5percent paired detector-hour cluster bootstrap intervals,2000 draws,seed51106; conditional on the three fixed seeds and five reference episodes.
intent.fresh_data_intent: Human-validated GravitySpy events with authentic four-window sources, excluding all identifiable previously consumed events and detector-hour groups. Metadata-label-based sampling is declared; prior195event confirmation is consumed and excluded.
intent.sample_size_intent: Up to100 events per target plus3000 outside-target negatives, subject to available untouched human-labeled events. Final identities and sizes frozen before fresh image acquisition or model scoring.
freeze_order: implementation checks on synthetic arrays and used fixtures
fresh image acquisition with label-independent integrity exclusions
claims_excluded: reusing the old confirmation as fresh data
limitations: Negative-aware matching contrast includes the benefit of using background FIT data, not just a different algebraic formula.
Five reference episodes and three seeds do not multiply the number of independent query events.
Low-alarm tail precision depends on actual available independent negatives; no advance promise of significance.

sampling.label_rule: At least5 distinct consistent registered voters, at least80% exact named label; no anonymous/machine votes; no cross-workflow pooling.
sampling.rule: O3a only; exclude all known prior IDs and detector-hours, with8s boundary buffer; targets first in declared order then hashed outside-target pool; one event per detector-hour across entire cohort; all4 authentic official URLs required.
limitations: Volunteer consensus is not expert adjudication; previous ML routing affected volunteer exposure.
Versions within a workflow can expose different vocabularies; exact named label, user consistency and source version counts are retained.
Class-stratified sampling changes prevalence; false alarms are per non-target event, not deployment precision.
Detector-hour separation does not prove physical independence across hours; detector imbalance remains.
Historical exact pixel hashes are incomplete; identity/time exclusion is primary.

references.policy: Original locked reference plus four SHA256-ordered positive DEV events; five distinct detector-hours within each target; no score/appearance selection. One event per classifier/episode, never pooled.

feature_storage: Feature arrays held in memory per model; persist SHA256 of dtype/shape-bound array bytes rather than redundant feature copies. Inputs, fitted states, thresholds and all scores retained.
eligible_exclusions: Same events for every condition; all four renders required; bounded download/integrity/independent-renderer validation; exact native/full-crop historical collision exclusions. No label/score/appearance-based replacement.
reporting: All three trained seeds and their paired random initializations, all five single-reference episodes and all four cells; no post-test selection or model changes.
test_labels_access: Metadata informed balanced sampling. Scoring runner opens labels only after all-score SHA256 commitment; this is prospective evaluation, not a label-blind sample.
scientific_status: New experiment separate from the submitted report. No modifications to historical confirmation, models, manuscript or application.
